Relays._comment: Main app owns CH1/CH2 only. CH3 (BCM 21) belongs to the firepit-watchdog service.

Igniter._comment: Main app owns Relay A only (BCM 5). Relay B (BCM 6) belongs to the firepit-igniter-watchdog service.

Flame._comment: Camera flame detector (firepit-flame, advisory). With gas ON and no flame seen (or detector down/stale) the igniter sparks until a flame is detected; after TrialSeconds with no flame the app stops the spark, CLOSES GAS and locks out until Open gas is pressed again. Set AutoIgnite=false to disable sparking (detector is then display-only).
